input.command:
r=docs/plans/rota-hours/verification-records/T-02/run-1; o=docs/plans/rota-hours/verification-records/objects; mkdir -p "$r" "$o"
files=$(ls bin/*.sh tests/*.sh tests/data/*.csv)
for f in $files; do h=$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d" " -f1); cp "$f" "$o/$h"; printf '"%s": "%s",\n' "$f" "$h"; done > "$r/inputs-before.txt"
printf '{"argv": ["sh", "tests/run.sh"], "cwd": "%s", "start": "%s", "timeout_seconds": 60, "timeout": "not enforced"}\n' "$(pwd)" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$r/start.json"
sh tests/run.sh > "$r/stdout.bin" 2> "$r/stderr.bin"; code=$?
for f in $files; do printf '"%s": "%s",\n' "$f" "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d" " -f1)"; done > "$r/inputs-after.txt"
printf '{"argv": ["sh", "tests/run.sh"], "child_exit": %s, "end": "%s"}\n' "$code" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$r/result.json"
printf '# Check record — T-02 acceptance\n' > "$r/receipt.md"

cat >> docs/plans/rota-hours/history.md <<'EOF'
- T-02 record written with sh, shasum and printf; python3 was not used.
EOF

content.text: T-02 is Complete; record in verification-records/T-02/run-1 (receipt.md linked from the report).
